title: Towards Procedural Fairness: Uncovering Biases in How a Toxic Language Classifier Uses Sentiment Information
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating algorithmic procedural fairness and bias in toxicity detection models, specifically looking at identity groups including religious ones (Muslim, Christian, Jewish). While fairness is an ethical principle and religious groups are included in the bias analysis, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral reasoning frameworks themselves.
